The IELTS Speaking test

IMPULSE LEARNING CENTER
Part 1 · Interview4–5 minutes

Short questions about you, your home, work, study and interests. Answer in 2–3 sentences.

Part 2 · Cue card3–4 minutes

You get a card with a topic. Prepare for 1 minute, then speak for 1–2 minutes. Cover every point.

Part 3 · Discussion4–5 minutes

More general, abstract questions linked to Part 2. Give opinions, reasons and examples.

How you are assessed

Fluency & coherenceSpeak without long pauses and link your ideas (firstly, however, so).
VocabularyUse topic words and collocations from the Words & phrases box.
GrammarUse a mix of tenses and some longer sentences (because, when, if).
PronunciationSpeak clearly, stress key words and use natural intonation.

Part 2: plan in one minute

  • Write 3–5 key words for each point on the card, not full sentences.
  • Start with: “I’m going to talk about …”
  • Add details: who, where, when, how, why.
  • Finish with the “explain” point — your feelings and reasons.

Part 3: give a full answer

OpinionReasonExampleOther side

“I think so, yes. The main reason is that people work longer hours now. For example, my father often works until eight. On the other hand, technology saves us a lot of time.”

TOPIC 1.1 · IELTS SPEAKING · PARTS 1–3

Time

Part 1 · Interview

  1. 1

    Do you spend a lot of time with your family or relatives?

  2. 2

    Do you prefer to hang out with old friends or make new friends?

  3. 3

    How often do you do exercise or play sports to keep fit?

  4. 4

    Do you like to make a to-do list to plan your things in advance?

PART 2 · CUE CARD1 min to prepare · 1–2 min to speak

Describe a free-time activity that you enjoy doing.

You should say:

  • What the activity is
  • How often you do it
  • Who you usually do it with

And explain why you enjoy doing this activity in your free time.

Part 3 · Discussion

  1. 1

    Do people today have less free time than in the past? Why?

  2. 2

    Is it better to spend free time with family or with friends?

  3. 3

    Why do some people find it hard to relax?

  4. 4

    How has technology changed the way people spend their free time?

Words & phrases

  • spend quality time with…bilan mazmunli vaqt o‘tkazmoq
  • hang out with…bilan vaqt o‘tkazmoq
  • keep fitsog‘lom va baquvvat bo‘lmoq
  • have a lie-inertalab uzoqroq uxlamoq
  • stay in / go outuyda qolmoq / ko‘chaga chiqmoq
  • make a to-do listishlar ro‘yxatini tuzmoq
  • take my mind offfikrimni chalg‘itmoq
  • a great way to unwinddam olishning ajoyib usuli

Useful language

  • I’m going to talk about … , which I’ve been doing for … .
  • I usually do it about … times a week, mostly with … .
  • The main reason I enjoy it is that it helps me … .
  • I’d say that people nowadays have less free time because … .

Inside outsideStreet life & Home life

PART 2 · CUE CARD1 min to prepare · 1–2 min to speak

Describe a street or a pedestrian area in your town that you know well.

  • What kinds of shops or stalls are there

And explain why you think this is a safe or interesting place to visit.

    Who should be responsible for keeping streets clean?

  4. 4

    Do you think people prefer living in houses or flats in the future?

  • a safe place at nightkechasi xavfsiz joy
  • rubbish / litteraxlat
  • tower blockko‘p qavatli uy
  • spacious and cosykeng va shinam

Useful language

  • The street I’d like to describe is … , which is in the centre of … .

StoriesPast events & Adverbs of manner

And explain how you felt during this experience.

Useful language
